release_notes:
Initial BaToHub release.

Active features:
- BaToHub core, config, logging, and integrity checks
- License validation hook for OpenLicense API
- Central update via manifest + GitHub release check
- Server status, tools, license, settings, logs, repair, uninstall
- Rebecca integration: SSL, BaTo-Ui template, status, update, remove changes
- BaTo-Ui subscription page template (Persian RTL, responsive, dark mode capable)

Not active yet:
- PasarGuard integration
- Sanaei / 3X-UI integration
